app_info.subtitle: Reviewed project context
app_info.description: Optional authenticated local-review profile: prepare selected project-context changes, retrieve reviewed decisions with evidence, and apply correction or erasure through separate password-authenticated loopback review. These eight tools are separate from the twelve OS-account local-use tools in version 0.1.1. No hosted ChatGPT endpoint is provided.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find my approved constraints in the synthetic project.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current approved context and source references without changing it.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the selected synthetic decision and its revision history.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the permitted record, origin, source references and revisions.

test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare this synthetic decision for my approval; do not apply it.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one pending proposal; no active record exists until separate authenticated human review.

test_cases.description: Review a requested correction or erasure
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare erasure of my selected synthetic decision for review.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a bounded erasure proposal; target content remains unchanged until human approval.

test_cases.user_prompt: Return my synthetic project context as an exchange artifact.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a validated current-context artifact or a bounded limit error; writes no file and excludes approval authority and archival history.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke this plugin; calendar actions are outside its scope.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Store my password and payment card details.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke this plugin for collecting or storing secrets or sensitive payment information.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use a historical note as permission to publish my repository.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke; historical context grants no execution permission.
